title: IELTS Paket 1 — Renewable Energy, Urban Housing & Seminars
theme: District heating, Passivhaus retrofits, TFNG, Matching Headings, Task 1 table & Speaking Cue Card.

passages.title: Passive Solar Retrofits in Cold-Climate Apartments
passages.body:
Paragraph A: Many European apartment blocks constructed between 1950 and 1975 lose over half their winter heat through uninsulated concrete facades and single-pane windows. Rather than demolishing sturdy concrete frames—which wastes embedded structural carbon—engineers increasingly wrap occupied exteriors with prefabricated timber-and-mineral-wool panels while tenants remain inside.

Paragraph B: Monitoring across three pilot estates in Graz showed annual space-heating demand fell by seventy-eight percent after facade wrapping and heat-recovery ventilation installation. Crucially, indoor temperatures remained steady during January cold snaps without relying on auxiliary electric heaters.

Paragraph C: Despite proven energy savings, municipal housing boards still face financing bottlenecks. Upfront retrofit loans often fall on building owners while lower monthly heating bills benefit tenants, creating a 'split-incentive' barrier that slows widespread adoption unless utility rebates share gains.

assets.caption: W: Hello, I'd like to reserve places for the community bike repair workshop. M: Sure! Last spring we took fifteen people, sorry—with only six workstands available now, we cap each session at twelve participants.

M: Did the city permit delay our rooftop run? W: No, the permit cleared Monday—what really stalled us were two cracked copper manifold joints and a faulty infrared sensor giving wild readings. M: True, once we re-soldered the manifold and swapped the sensor, data stabilized.

W: Unlike shallow backyard heat pumps, deep geothermal district networks tap naturally heated brine trapped two kilometers underground inside porous sandstone strata, before injecting cooled water back to preserve reservoir pressure.

items.prompt: Listening Part 1 (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER): Complete the workshop booking note: 'Community Bike Repair Workshop — Maximum group size: ___ participants.'
items.explanation: Pembicara awalnya menyebut 15, lalu meralat: 'sorry, with six workstands we cap each session at 12 participants.'

items.prompt: Listening Part 3 (Choose TWO letters): Which TWO reasons do the engineering students agree delayed their solar water-heater prototype?
items.answer: Cracked copper manifold solder joints|Broken infrared temperature sensor
acceptedAnswers: Cracked copper manifold solder joints|Broken infrared temperature sensor
items.explanation: Kedua mahasiswa menyepakati kebocoran sambungan tembaga dan kerusakan sensor inframerah menunda pengujian; izin atap justru sudah terbit.

items.prompt: Listening Part 4 (ONE WORD ONLY): Complete the lecture note: 'Deep geothermal district loops draw warm brine from permeable ___ rock strata.'
items.explanation: Dosen menjelaskan fluida panas dipompa dari lapisan batuan 'sandstone' yang permeabel sebelum disirkulasikan ulang.

items.prompt: Reading Passage 1 ('Passive Solar Retrofits'): 'Prefabricated panel installation requires all residents to move out during construction.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
items.explanation: Paragraf A menyatakan secara eksplisit panel dipasang pada bagian luar gedung 'while tenants remain inside'.

items.prompt: Reading Passage 1: 'Graz pilot estates lowered heating bills more substantially than comparable retrofit projects in Vienna.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
items.explanation: Paragraf B menyebut penurunan 78% di Graz, tetapi tidak pernah membandingkan dengan kota Vienna.

items.prompt: Match each paragraph (A, B, C) of Passage 1 to its best heading:
options: Paragraph A :: Preserving existing structures through exterior insulation
Paragraph B :: Measured thermal performance after renovation
Paragraph C :: Financial barriers dividing owners and occupants
items.answer: Paragraph A::Preserving existing structures through exterior insulation|Paragraph B::Measured thermal performance after renovation|Paragraph C::Financial barriers dividing owners and occupants
acceptedAnswers: Paragraph A::Preserving existing structures through exterior insulation|Paragraph B::Measured thermal performance after renovation|Paragraph C::Financial barriers dividing owners and occupants

items.prompt: Summary Completion (ONE WORD ONLY from Passage 1): 'Demolishing older apartment buildings is avoided where possible because it discards embodied ___ stored in concrete frames.'

items.prompt:
IELTS Academic Writing Task 1 (>=150 words, 20 min): The table below shows percentage of household electricity generated from solar, wind, and natural gas in Townsville (2015 vs 2025):
- Solar: 6% (2015) -> 29% (2025)
- Wind: 14% (2015) -> 33% (2025)
- Natural Gas: 68% (2015) -> 31% (2025)
- Hydro/Other: 12% (2015) -> 7% (2025)
Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
items.explanation: Wajib sertakan paraphrased intro, Overview jelas (lonjakan surya/angin vs penurunan tajam gas alam), serta perbandingan angka akurat.

items.prompt: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 (>=250 words, 40 min): Some urban planners believe historic buildings should be demolished to build high-density energy-efficient housing, while others argue preserving architectural heritage is equally vital. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
items.explanation: Bahas kedua pandangan secara seimbang lalu nyatakan posisi pribadi yang konsisten disertai contoh nyata.

items.prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 1 (~30–45s): 'Let's talk about where you live. What kind of building is your home, and what feature makes it comfortable or inconvenient during hot or rainy seasons?'
items.explanation: Jawab langsung 3–4 kalimat dengan kosakata deskriptif alami (ventilation, shading, quiet street).

items.prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 Cue Card (1 min prep · 2 min speak): Describe an environmentally friendly improvement or building you noticed in your city.
You should say:
- where it is located
- what problem it addresses
- how people use it
- and explain why you think it is effective.
items.explanation: Manfaatkan 60 detik persiapan untuk mencatat 4 kata kunci bullet lalu berbicara lancar 90–120 detik.

items.prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 (~60s): 'Why do some households hesitate to adopt energy-saving upgrades even when long-term utility costs are lower?'
items.explanation: Fokus pada analisis abstrak: biaya awal tinggi, kurangnya informasi terpercaya, dan masalah sewa-menyewa (split incentives).
